"""Worst-case preparation: 2048 distinct masks over 16384 transitions."""
import json, random, sys, time
import kit

STATES = 512
TRANSITIONS = 16384
RUNS = 2048
names = ["S%d" % i for i in range(STATES)]
types = [{"name": "ST", "kind": "enum", "values": names},
         {"name": "M", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 1},
         {"name": "N", "kind": "int", "bits": 16},
         {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["st", "ST"], ["msg", "M"], ["n", "N"]],
            "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None}]
random.seed(11)
seen = set()
items = []
while len(items) < TRANSITIONS:
    frm = random.randrange(STATES)
    to = random.randrange(STATES)
    command = "c%05d" % len(items)
    if (frm, command) in seen:
        continue
    seen.add((frm, command))
    if len(items) < 2048:
        guard = ["ge", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", len(items)]]
    else:
        guard = None
    items.append({"from": names[frm], "to": names[to], "command": command,
                  "cost": random.randrange(1, 65535), "when": guard})
machine = {"states": names, "initial": names[0], "state_param": "st",
           "message_param": "msg", "transitions": items}
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["m"], "machine": machine, "runs": []}
_, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
target = names.index(names[-1])
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
    [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in zip(plan["slots"], [target, 120, i, 0])])}
    for i in range(RUNS)]
start = time.time()
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print("preparation worst case %6.2fs" % (time.time() - start))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(r["status"] for r in out["records"]))
print(max((c["cost"] for c in out["corpus"]), default=None),
      max(len(c["commands"]) for c in out["corpus"], default=0))
PYEOF
